content: Yesus po Anawayo Vambunine raurairive
Risyirati Lukas, syo bukuge so ratoe Teopilus nai. Wusyinoe sya bukugo manasyine syo ratoe nai to, wemirati syo Yesus apa anakero po raijar muno Apa ananyao po raugaje ratoe tenambe rai.

Ana syo ratoe no bukugo namije rai mamo arono manasyimbe Yesus po apa arakove mawain utavondi Ai muno Po Anawayo Vambunine ama vambunine veano mansanyao, mansanan ava masyoto Amisye po auga seo no munijo ntiti.

Arono Yesus seo rainyamo, siuri rati muno kakai, umba masyote tename jirum Po taune aroron indamu Apa arakove wo aen ti wanave ware, “Tugae, Yesus opamo kovakato.” Arono naije Po mansanyao irati masyoto Amisye indati de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine so raije rai.
Masyote inta pisyisyo matavon, umba Po matutir pare, “Vemo wapo Yerusalem rapaya inya, yara wana indamu wapo ana Amisye po raurairive wasaije ranyut. Omamo Syo raura wasaive to.
Yohanes po vatane maugasya kuvuni mana rai, weramu masyote kavinta yai jakato, umba Anawayo Vambunine maje irati wasai.”
Amisye po Yesus auga seo no munijo ntiti
Masyote inta rai jakato, Yesusa pe apa arakove nawe wanunugambe, umba wo Yesus anajo ware, “Injayo Kurune, soamo nyare Nyo munijo Israel raugakasea ntet akato muno wimbe akarive rai rako?”
Weramu Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Injayo Amisy wepi po ama masyote rapatimu, taune bo Apa varore mije. Weti weapare wapo masyote so raen, omamo mamaisye ramu.

Kavinta indati Amisye po apa Anawayo Vambunine raugaje wasai indamu wapo Ama vambunine raijar. Indati wapo rinaura kakavimbe no munijo Yerusalem muno Yudea muno Samaria muno mine tename so rai tenambea nto ama marane rai.”
Yesus po ayaowe umaso raura mansaija jewen, umba Amisye po aijaseo no munijo ntiti. Apa arakove wo anyanyuto seowi, wo anyanyut ava kamure inta nande no aora ti wo aen akatoe ramu.
Mami ntami tawan no naumo warae, kavuratawe inda vatane jirum nyande syayai no mansamun. Aya ansune mpope dave.

Yo maura nande yare, “Inya, vatano Galilea! Wabeanimaibe wasayai wapo naumo warae ranyuta no?! Yesus, napirati Amisye po augave seo no naumo warae, indati pakare akato maisyare muno Apa seo ti wapo anyanyute so ramaisy.”
Yesus apa arakove wo vatane inta apatimu indamu po Yudas anigwan
Arono naije Yesus apa arakove umaso una no Pukamo Saitun, weti wanya wakare no Yerusalem. Nggwaravainye ramu, yara ama tauno waravainye mamo kilometer intabo.
Unande no Yerusalem, naije wuruta no awa yavaro una raije rai. Usea no tanoane inta rai no yavare ama ranivono warae. Arakove umaso awa tame mi so:
Arakove umaso wanunugambe, manuga mamo intabo muno ube sambayambe tutir. Naije Yesus apa rijate nawe Apa akoe Maria me muno wanya kaijinta utavondi tavon.
Masyote inta arakovo wanave Yesus aije wanunugambe, awa wanuije nanto no tename kaujentabo (120), umba Petrus seo tet indamu payao nanto mai.

Po raura pare, “Sya arakove weap! Ana nande Yudas aijoe omamo nande indamu mamaisyo Ayao Amisye rai. Weye wusyinoe Anawayo Vambunine mo Yudas umaso aura ti Daud po ratoe. Yudas wepirati po naite maugav inda wo Yesus aijar.
Opamo ato siso no Yesus apa arakove reansai muno po Apa anakere raijaro reansarijat.”
(Yudas umaso po Yesus amavun, umba po doije umaso raveano mine inta ramavun. Mine umaso mirati to tende rai, anobone mporar apa wanyati ntimuje yara kakai kobe.
Vatano utantuna no Yerusalem wo ranaun tenambe. Weti wo tame raugaje mine umaso rai, wo rawaino awa ayao rai ware Akeldama, ama ine mare Kopa Mavu.)
Petrus po raura iridi pare, “Ayao kovo Mazmur mo Kopa Mavu umaso raurairive taiso:

content.text: ‘Apa mino namije rapaya ntami vayave kai;
vemo vatane inta una rai jinya.’

content: Muno ayao inta mo ratoe akato mare,

content.text: ‘Apa teto raije wemamo vatano kaijinta po ranigwan kai.’

content: Maisyare omai ti, sya arakove weap, syo raura wasai: Koveamo vatano kaijinta po Yudas anigwan inda tavondijo wansai, indamu po Yesus apa kovakato raura kakavimbe tavon. Weti arakovo nanawirati utavono Amisy Yesus ai kobe no arono Yohanes po augasyo kuvuni mana raijoe mansanan ava Amisye po auga seo no munijo ntiti onawamo wamo mansaen tenambe inda wamo arakove inta apatimu tavondi wansai.”
Weti naije wo vatane jiruma yatayao, aya tame mirati Matias muno Yusup awain tavonamo Barsabas (muno apa tamo Roma mamo Yustus).
Umba ube sambayambe ware, “Amisyo winy, Nyo vatane manuga raen tenambe. Weti are pirati Nyo apatimu, wepamo Nyo arorono reansai,
indamu po Yudas apa teto raije ranigwan weye Yudas po rapaya to, to no apa siurije rai. Nyo vatano po anigwane apatimu indamu tavondijo Yesus apa arakove reansai reamo Nya anakere raijar.”
Umba wo aikarae rapatin no vatano jirume umaso yai. Muno Matias wepirati mo aroron, weti Yesus apa arakovo po mansatutire mansano abusyinara eane intabo wo augave siso matavon.
